name: tabby-server-panel
description: A Tabby Terminal plugin providing a three-layer bottom panel for SSH sessions: server stats, quick commands, and file manager
// ANGULAR_VERSION_NOTE: Angular devDependencies are pinned to ^15.2.6 to match Tabby's Angular 15 host runtime. Upgrading to Angular 19+ (the version with CVE patches) would generate decorator metadata incompatible with Tabby's runtime. These packages are build-time only and are excluded from the plugin bundle via webpack externals. See README Security section for CVE applicability analysis.
